blocks.text: Why SEO analysts choose Notion on Mac

SEO work involves constant context switching. You move from Screaming Frog to Google Analytics and then to a client email. Notion acts as your single source of truth. Installing the Notion desktop app on your Mac keeps your workspace separate from your browsing habits. Use ⌘ 1, ⌘ 2, and ⌘ 3 to jump between your sidebar items quickly.

Stop using static spreadsheets for audits. Create a database in Notion to track site health. Use properties like Status, Priority, and URL. You can filter these views by priority to focus on critical errors. If you need to see only broken links, use the Filter menu at the top of your database. This keeps your audit actionable and clear for stakeholders.

Dictation is a secret weapon for SEOs. When you finish a crawl, you have many findings to summarize. Hold fn and talk to dictate your analysis directly into a Notion page. Lazur formats the text as you speak. This saves you from typing out repetitive audit summaries. You can also ask Lazur to draft a follow-up email based on your Notion notes.
How to organize your SEO workspace

items: Create a master database for all your projects.
Use templates for recurring tasks like monthly reports.
Add a Table of Contents to long audit pages.
Use callouts to highlight important action items for developers.
Embed your Google Sheets directly to keep live data visible.

blocks.text: Efficiency in Notion comes from avoiding the mouse. Type / to open the command menu. You can insert tables, images, or even code blocks for your schema markup testing. If you are stuck, ask Lazur to point at the menu you need. Lazur will draw a circle around the correct path.

Client reports often get lost in email chains. Create a dedicated client page in Notion. Share this page with the client so they can see progress in real time. Use a Kanban board to show what tasks are In Progress, In Review, or Done. This reduces the need for constant status updates via email.

blocks.text: Research can take hours. When you use Lazur, you can offload the heavy lifting. Ask Lazur to research a topic. It will open its own Chrome tabs, gather the information, and return a summary. Paste this into your Notion research page. This keeps your workflow moving without leaving your app.

faq.question: Can I use Notion for free as a solo SEO analyst?
faq.answer: Yes. The 1,000-block limit only applies to workspaces with two or more members. As a solo user, you have plenty of room to build your SEO database.

faq.question: How does Lazur help me in Notion?
faq.answer: Lazur helps you by answering questions about your screen, guiding you through menu paths, and dictating text directly into your pages. Hold the shortcut to start.

faq.question: What is the best way to start an audit in Notion?
faq.answer: Start by creating a database. Use columns for URL, Issue Type, Priority, and Status. This allows you to filter and sort your findings easily.

faq.question: Does Lazur work with other SEO tools on my Mac?
faq.answer: Lazur works in any app on your Mac. You can use it to help you navigate Screaming Frog or other desktop-based SEO software.

faq.question: How can I improve my typing speed for SEO reports?
faq.answer: Use Lazur's dictation feature by holding fn. It is faster and often more accurate than manual typing for long reports.
